messages.subject: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
messages.subject_clean: The MPlus error message prior to "MODEL FIT INFORMATION"
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I just updated the MplusAutmoation to the latest version, and it works very well, especially for reading in data (not sure why it didn't work previous though). I found that although the "readModels" command can now read warnings (like "*** WARNING") from the output, I am not sure if reads the error message sometimes Mplus gives when the model terminatesly normally. Below is an example.

Is there anyway to get it, because when number of models is huge, it is impossible to check the output file one by one, yet it could imply distrubst for the model results, as well as influence the other functions in the MplusAutomation - for example when this happens, somehow I could no longer read in the saved factor scores.

Thanks a lot! -Kate

THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY

     THIS COULD INDICATE A NEGATIVE VARIANCE/RESIDUAL VARIANCE FOR AN OBSERVED
     VARIABLE, A CORRELATION GREATER OR EQUAL TO ONE BETWEEN TWO OBSERVED
     VARIABLES, OR A LINEAR DEPENDENCY AMONG MORE THAN TWO OBSERVED VARIABLES.
     CHECK THE RESULTS SECTION FOR MORE INFORMATION.
     PROBLEM INVOLVING VARIABLE KPSE1882.

     WARNING:  THE RESIDUAL COVARIANCE MATRIX (THETA) IS NOT POSITIVE DEFINITE.
     THIS COULD INDICATE A NEGATIVE VARIANCE/RESIDUAL VARIANCE FOR AN OBSERVED
     VARIABLE, A CORRELATION GREATER OR EQUAL TO ONE BETWEEN TWO OBSERVED
     VARIABLES, OR A LINEAR DEPENDENCY AMONG MORE THAN TWO OBSERVED VARIABLES.
     CHECK THE RESULTS SECTION FOR MORE INFORMATION.

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm a newbie with MPlusAutomation and with mac and got a problem which occurs only on a mac, not on a PC.

When I want to run "createModels", I get this message:

Read 26 items
Error in `[.data.frame`(bodyTags, , tagType %in% c("simple", "iterator",  :
  undefined columns selected

Maybe someone has had this before or has an idea?

These are my settings:

> sessionInfo()
R version 2.15.2 (2012-10-26)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin9.8.0/x86_64 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] sv_SE.UTF-8/sv_SE.UTF-8/sv_SE.UTF-8/C/sv_SE.UTF-8/sv_SE.UTF-8

attached base packages:
[1] tcltk     stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base

other attached packages:
[1] foreign_0.8-52        MplusAutomation_0.5-4 plyr_1.8

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] coda_0.16-1     grid_2.15.2     gsubfn_0.6-5    lattice_0.20-14 proto_0.3-10    relimp_1.0-3
[7] tools_2.15.2    xtable_1.7-1

There seems to be no basic problem with my copy of the MplusAutomation package, because it can run the "runModels" command. I formatted the data file using "prepareMplusData" and the resulting .dat file looks ok. I stored the template file as plain text in UTF-8 format using TextEdit.

Thanks a lot in advance for any hint!
Ylva

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Error in divideIntoFields(input$analysis) :
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I have the same "problem" with another command and figured it out rather quickly, but wanted to report it anyway. The offending syntax in my case was:

Error in divideIntoFields(input$variable) :
  First line not dividing into LHS and RHS:    USEOBS Screen EQ 1

Be well,
Caspar

On Tuesday, February 19, 2013 6:00:04 AM UTC+1, Joshua Wiley wrote:
> Hi Frances,
>
> Glad to hear it.  I think that Mplus is pretty lax about not requiring
> ARE/IS/=, but that is how the MplusAutomation package knows the
> section versus input.  Unforunately, Mplus does not return output in a
> single structured form, so to get it into R, we must parse the text
> file based on certain rules, such as commands to the left of certain
> delimitters, variables, input, etc. on the right.
>
> Cheers,
>
> Josh
>
>
> On Mon, Feb 18, 2013 at 8:50 PM, Frances Garden
> <frances.g...@gmail.com> wrote:
> > Hi Josh
> >
> > Thanks for getting back to me.  I checked my mplus code and i don't have
> > "lrstarts =" I just have "lrstarts 0 0 100 25".  The mplus programs runs ok
> > and the extract model summaries has always previously worked without the =
> > sign.  I'll just change all my input and output code.
> >
> > Thanks again
> >
> > Frances
> >
> >
> > On Tue, Feb 19, 2013 at 1:00 PM, Joshua Wiley <jwiley...@gmail.com>
> > wrote:
> >>
> >> Hi Frances,
> >>
> >> Can you post (or privately message me if you do not want it public)
> >> your output file?  In particular, I wonder if you do not have:
> >>
> >> lrtstarts = 0 0 100 25
> >>
> >> because the package parses left and right hand side by the Mplus
> >> keywords ARE/IS/=, so I would understand that warning if you did not
> >> have any equals sign.
> >>
> >> Anyway, if you can send the .out file that would be tremendously
> >> helpful --- it is much easier to help and provide assistance with an
> >> example to work off of :)
> >>
> >> Cheers,
> >>
> >> Josh
